final_observable_contract: A V4A Add target or Move destination is available only after the file backend explicitly confirms that its directory entry is absent. A dangling symlink, unreadable entry, failed transport, or untyped legacy error refuses the entire patch before an earlier operation writes. Add and Move recheck immediately before their effects; a normal symlink to a regular file still reads normally.
